parameters.name: AltSvc
parameters.description:
Feature switch, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: AltSvcClear
parameters.description:
Whether the Alt-Svc header includes the clear parameter, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: AltSvcMa
parameters.description: Alt-Svc validity period, in seconds, default is 86400 seconds.

parameters.name: AltSvcPersist
parameters.description:
Whether the Alt-Svc header includes the persist parameter, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Hsts
parameters.description:
Whether to enable HSTS, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HstsIncludeSubdomains
parameters.description:
Whether to include subdomains in HSTS, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HstsPreload
parameters.description:
Whether to enable HSTS preload, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HttpsForce
parameters.description:
Whether to enable forced HTTPS, default is disabled. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HttpsForceCode
parameters.description:
Forced HTTPS redirect status code, value range:
- 301
- 302
- 307
- 308

parameters.name: HttpsNoSniDeny
parameters.description:
Whether to deny TLS handshake requests without Server Name Indication (SNI). Disabled by default. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HttpsSniVerify
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable SNI validation. By default, it is disabled. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: HttpsSniWhitelist
parameters.description: Specifies the whitelist of allowed SNI entries, separated by spaces.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Value range:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. Rules with smaller values are executed first.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) interface.
